falseFriends.station: Use 'darba vieta' for workstation, not 'stacija' alone (train/power station)
falseFriends.idle: Use 'dīkgaita' for machine idle, not 'slinks' (lazy — pejorative)
falseFriends.order: Use 'ražošanas pasūtījums' for production order, not 'kārtība' (tidiness)

grammarNotes.caseSystem: 7 cases. Nominative for labels: 'pieejamība'; genitive: 'pieejamības rādītājs'.
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Two genders. Adjectives agree: 'tehniskā pieejamība' (f) vs 'ideālais cikla laiks' (m).
grammarNotes.genitiveCompounds: Genitive constructions: 'cikla laiks' (cycle time). Analytic phrases, not single words.
grammarNotes.longVowelMacrons: Macrons (ā, ē, ī, ū) mandatory — change word meaning: 'māte' (mother) vs 'mate' (checkmate).
grammarNotes.definiteAdjectives: Distinct definite (-ais/-ā) and indefinite forms: 'kopējā efektivitāte' (the overall effectiveness).
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Comma decimal, space thousands. Percentage: '85,5 %' (space before %).
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In genitive compound phrases, only the HEAD noun pluralizes. The genitive modifier stays SINGULAR. CORRECT: 'ātruma zuduma iemesli' (speed [gen.sg] + loss [gen.sg] + reasons [nom.pl]). WRONG: 'ātruma zudumu iemesli' (speed [gen.sg] + losses [gen.pl] + reasons). The modifier 'zuduma' names the category of loss, not individual loss events.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE universal. Full Latvian: 'kopējā iekārtu efektivitāte'. Factors: pieejamība x veiktspēja x kvalitāte.
industryContext.manufacturingSectors: Wood/timber (largest export), food processing, electronics, metalworking

commonMistakes: Freezing all nouns in nominative — must decline correctly across 7 cases
Using 'performanse' instead of 'veiktspēja' for OEE performance
Omitting macrons (ā, ē, ī, ū) — mandatory, changes meaning
Using indefinite adjective where definite required

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'ātruma zudumu iemesli' (WRONG — 'zudumu' is genitive plural) instead of 'ātruma zuduma iemesli' (CORRECT — 'zuduma' is genitive singular). The modifier names the category; only the head noun takes plural
notes: OEE universal. Formal Jūs (capitalized). 7-case system. NOT Slavic (Baltic). More compact than Lithuanian (3.0 vs 3.5). Mandatory macrons.
